frontmatter.summary: Which instant represents a scene in its PNG thumbnail: the W4 still time, the middle, the busiest moment or the last moment before the exit.
frontmatter.recommendation: The still time of W4: three quarters through, or the middle of the busiest state when items have times. Cheap and already the strip's rule.
